template.name: Truck

location.name: Driving
location.label: 1:vehicles[id].type.speed

Driving: Active movement state. Utilizes an exponential rate (1:vehicles[id].type.speed) to trigger the stochastic transition. This simulates variable-speed, continuous movement independent of the central discrete clock.

transition.label: update_truck()
Driving -> Driving: Stochastic movement trigger. Executes update_truck() to advance the vehicle's position and handle Torus wrapping.

template.name: GameEngine

location.name: Active
location.label: t <= 1
Active State: Passively tracks time up to 1 unit (0.1s). Acts as the primary delay state between physics updates.

location.name: Evaluating
location.label: Evaluating State: Freezes time to atomically resolve collisions immediately after a physics update. Guarantees hazard detection before time advances.

transition.label: is_deadly()
die!
Evaluating -> Active (#2): Hazard detected on Frogger's exact coordinates. Actively pushes the 'die!' interrupt to kill Frogger while time is paused.
!is_deadly()
Evaluating -> Active (#1): Frogger's current coordinates are safe. The engine returns to the passive wait state.
t >= 1
t = 0, update_game()
Active -> Evaluating: Triggers the physics update. Resets the engine clock 't' and advances all vehicle/float arrays by one tick.

template.name: Frogger

location.name: GameStart
location.label: GameStart: Initializes the game. Committed to ensure Frogger is repositioned atomically at t=0.

location.name: Waiting
location.label: move_timer <= RESPAWN_DELAY
Waiting: Locks Frogger in the starting bay for the duration of RESPAWN_DELAY. Simulates the arcade respawn animation/pause.

location.name: Playing
location.label: move_timer <= 1 && game_timer <= current_timeout
Playing: The core active state. Constrained by the level's timeout invariant. Frogger remains here between discrete jumps.

location.name: CheckState
location.label: CheckState: Freezes time instantly upon a jump execution to evaluate if the new destination is safe, deadly, or a scoring bay.

location.name: Dead
location.label: Dead: Intermediate state for processing a life loss. Atomically evaluates whether to trigger a respawn or GameOver.

location.name: Scored
location.label: Scored: Intermediate state for processing a successful run. Atomically adds points and evaluates whether the game is won.

transition.label: move_timer >= 1
move_timer = 0
Playing -> CheckState: Stochastic decision node. UPPAAL rolls the probabilistic weights (UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT) defined in the Strategy Selector to dictate the movement direction.
die?
record_death_cause()
Playing -> Dead (#1): Asynchronous interrupt. The environment crushed or drowned Frogger while he was standing still.
!is_home_bay() && !is_deadly()
CheckState -> Playing: Destination is an empty road or safe platform. Returns control to the player.
is_home_bay() && !is_deadly()
score += BAY_FILLED_SCORE, bay_occupied[frog_x / 4] = true, home_bays_filled++
CheckState -> Scored: Success. The player accurately jumped into an empty home bay
is_deadly()
record_death_cause()
CheckState -> Dead: Active suicide. The player jumped directly into a hazard or into the water without a log.
game_timer >= current_timeout
stat_timeout++, stat_total_lifespan += fint(game_timer), stat_lifespan_to_die = fint(game_timer)
Playing -> Dead (#2): Time Over. The player failed to reach a bay before the timer expired.
move_timer >= RESPAWN_DELAY
game_timer = 0, move_timer = 0
Waiting -> Playing: Respawn delay complete. Unlocks Frogger's movement and resets the global stage timer.

query.formula: Pr[<=TAU] (<> Frogger.level == 1 && Frogger.Scored && home_bays_filled == 5 && score >= 200 - LEVEL_WON_SCORE)
query.comment: Simulate the game for a maximum of 1000 time units and estimate the probability of completing the first level while scoring at least 200 points. To circumvent the atomicity of the complete_level() function, which synchronously applies the level completion bonus, the query intercepts the committed Scored location exactly when the fifth bay is filled but before the subsequent transition resolves.
